hold_reason: Refund for order 322 (1602 cents) was requested in the signed batch but is absent from the refund ledger (list_refunds shows only orders 320 and 325). W2 reported only 320 and 325 as applied. Paying now would overpay the customer on order 322. Needs review and the 322 refund applied before payouts.

reply.thought: W2 reported only two of the three requested refunds as applied; order 322 ($1602) is missing. I'll check the refund ledger before paying anyone, since a payout can't be recalled.

The refund ledger has only orders 320 and 325. Order 322's $1602 refund was requested in the signed batch but never applied, so net balances computed now would overpay that order's customer. Payouts can't be recalled, so I'll hold the batch for review.
